title: Console: an app opens on the first `landing` entry whose `visible` predicate holds
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ② the `domain:ui` half of a maintainer-ruled card: #28022, ruling 6545223246, letter A (maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T15:10Z), "spec first (this card, seat 2), then a `domain:ui` card for the redirect". The spec half is PR #28449. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reach: any app shared by more than one audience. In HotCRM, moving Sales above Service moves service staff's landing to Leads (#27386 row 5).
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`. Lands after PR #28449 is on `main`.
Duplicate search: "app landing visible predicate console redirect" → #28022 (the spec half), #23610 (closed, wording). New.

## Observed (after PR #28449)

- `AppSchema.landing` is `[{ item, visible }]`: each entry names a navigation item, the first entry whose `visible` predicate holds is the landing, no match falls back to the first navigation item by `order`. A dangling item, a group / separator / action target and a data read are refused at parse (`checkAppLandingItems`).
- Its liveness row is `planned` with an author warning: the console does not read the key yet, so an app still opens on its first navigation item.

## Wanted

- The console landing redirect (`AppContent` landing resolution) reads `landing` and evaluates each `visible` predicate in the same scope app navigation `visible` uses; first match wins; no match keeps today's rule. Decide and pin which roots the predicate may read (PR #28449's acceptance note: no root verdict yet).
- Attach `checkAppLandingItems` to objectui's `AppComponentSchema` and drop the `notAttachable` entry PR #28449 added in `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`.
- Flip the liveness row `app.landing` to `live`, and re-classify the dogfood `cel-app-landing` conformance row.

Dedupe words: app landing per audience, landing visible predicate, console landing redirect.

Links back: #28022, PR #28449, #27386 (row 5).

Blocked-by: #28449
